description: Lists payments that reached the merchant's own Tron wallet but matched no invoice, newest first. Needs a store key (npx stablevoy-mcp login). This usually happens when an exchange took its fee out of the amount. At most the 100 newest are returned; there is no paging past them. Each transfer has amountUsd, network, token, fromAddress, txHash, explorerUrl, detectedAt and the stores it was listed for. sharedWithStores counts the active stores that pay out to that wallet on that network. 1 means the transfer is that store's; more means it may belong to any of them. You cannot attach a transfer to an invoice: tell the merchant to do it in the Stablevoy dashboard, Unmatched transfers section. Use get_invoice or list_invoices to find the invoice the buyer meant. Without store and with several stores, every store is asked and each transfer is listed once. A failure comes back as an error with its code and what to do, for example rate_limited with the seconds to wait.

store.description: Store id or exact store name from list_stores. Needed only when several stores are connected.
